lot.name: Storage Unit Office
lot.desc: Identical roll-up-doors line the poorly lit hallways. Dented, stained, and smelly, some of these have been lived and certainly died in. Down one of the corridors, you hear a song you definitely recognize and the hum of a familiar amplifier.

acts.label: Speak with Higgins, the night clerk
Dig through dumpster. (people throw away great shit at a storage unit)
acts.say: Half buried in the gravel: a fuzz pedal with a wine cork for a knob. It still works. It should not still work.

acts.label: Fight your repulsion and walk towards the musical sounds

row.name: Row C
row.desc: The four chords are louder here. And sure enough, four instrument pedals are zip-tied to the outside the locked door. You feel a chill and taste the despair in the air...

counter.name: The Counter
counter.desc: Hoffman has the best selection of pedals in town. He definitely hates you after all the haggling you've attempted over the years, but he's open 24/7 and let's you work on your rig in his shop.

counter.name: The Nite Owl
counter.desc: Sticky tables and a jukebox rigged to play for free. This place has always been the band's safe place. Every band member you've saved is here and you can chat with them. Rest for the night to heal the full party stats, or buy individual dishes to help single members.

openmic.name: Ozark Open Mic
openmic.locked: A moldy event room. You'll need to rescue Beau before going here.

room.name: The Room
room.desc: The same crowd every time and 6 different "theme" nights on the calendar. The battles are unique and the money is real. Maybe you could earn that pedal-money after all. Pays more than streaming revenue!

acts.label: NIGHT FOUR — The Sound Guy Left
NIGHT FIVE — Battle Of The Bands

ozarks.name: Lake of the Ozarks
ozarks.locked: Nathaniel is submerged in here somewhere, but you'll need Beau's help to fish him out.

marina.name: Marina B, Off-Season
marina.desc: Ahhh... L.O.T.O. in the off-season. The smell of fish and water you can't see 4 inches into. Somewhere beyond the eerily vacant and numerous boat slips, drumming can be heard from under the water's frothy crests, keeping perfect time.

acts.label: Rummage through the bait cooler (Worsts case scenario, free bait!)
acts.say: Under two bags of ice and a decade of regret: a reverb pedal, still dry inside its bag.

acts.label: Look at the pontoon
acts.say: No keys. The dockhand has them, and the dockhand has opinions.

water.name: Out Past The Buoys
water.desc: The drumming is much louder out here, along with the waves. The lake is quiet except for a few jet skis circling ominously around where the drums seem to be coming from beneath the dark water.

acts.label: Follow the sound of the drumming

cstreet.name: C-Street
cstreet.locked: Four blocks, 200 years of grime, and a bassist in hiding. Get Nathaniel before braving the North Side.

blocks.name: Brick Back Alleys
blocks.desc: With brick store fronts, ancient railroad tracks to trip over, and spotty string lights, this scene hasn't changed in 200 years. In one of these former warehouses turned overpriced loft is Mat. Just where you left him. But he's not making himself known...

acts.label: Talk to the Open Mic host
Rummage through abandoned Street Craps game (You've dug through worse)
acts.say: Nine cables. Eight are dead. You test them all, because you have been in a band.

acts.label: Walk to the Cashew Chicken counter

record.name: Not Real Record Store
record.desc: The owner has a system for organizing his vinyl that you'd need an abacus and sundial to understand. He will NOT let you listen to a record before buying it. You've asked before...

acts.label: Grab a record from the owner's secret stash
acts.say: Third from the back. No sleeve, no label, worn smooth on the A-side. He was right about the B-side.

counter.name: The Cashew Chicken Counter
counter.desc: The classic aroma of Springield's OG Cashew Chicken fills your face-holes, and it stings. Hope you like your bathroom! Looks like there's only one serving left and the employee is limping around in pain.

backroom.name: Mat's Hiding Spot
backroom.desc: A door with no knob, but someone's been leaving their recycling out every week. From beyond the door, you hear the whir of an aging cassette tape being constantly rewound over and over again. Has this been going on for years? A small slot has been fitted on the front of the door.

acts.label: Slide food through slot
acts.say: You slide all three under the door. A long pause. Then: "...okay. Okay. But we do this my way."

vfw.name: The VFW Hall
vfw.locked: Kevin has been volunteering to run sound here for ever. You'll need to bust Mat out first.

lotvfw.name: The Parking Lot
lotvfw.desc: Cash only, no alcohol, and 8 people waiting to get in. You've seen worse in towns like these. You can still smell last Friday's Fish Fry lingering.

acts.label: Talk to the kid working the door
Dig through the donation box. (no one is looking)
acts.say: Taped under the cash box, where somebody hid it from somebody: a compressor. Still has the tape.

hallvfw.name: The Hall
hallvfw.desc: Moldy drop ceiling and forty bend-up folding chairs crowd the dance floor around the 9 attendees. No one is speaking to each other. The squeal from the PA is mind numbing and you suddenly forgot what your pets look like. You gotta stop that feedback. A familiar face sits behind the board.

acts.label: Talk to the man behind the board

stagevfw.name: The Stage
stagevfw.desc: A one foot riser and single, crackling wedge monitor. In the back of the crowd is something really big, even before it stands up. Is it a full moon tonight?

kfat.name: Community Radio KFUX
kfat.locked: Brian is in there somewhere, possibly under the DJ name "Mr. Rhythm".

gate.name: Radio Station Tower
gate.desc: The remains of a chain link fence surround a condemnable cinderblock building.  The tower above used to have blinking lights, but local plain traffic learned to avoid the area. A faded out sign says "Listener Supported". A second sign says, "Please?!".

acts.label: Talk to the volunteer on the steps
Check the lost-and-found bin  (pedal)
acts.say: A milk crate of things nobody claimed since the Bush administration. Under a hat: an Octave Down.

stacks.name: The Record Library
stacks.desc: Rotting cassette tapes line the shelves near a pile of headphones and caffeine pills. Nearby, a logbook is already opened on the radio transmitter console.

booth.name: Studio A
booth.desc: 8 tracks, CD's, and a coffee pot who's contents has gained sentience. Below the fading On-Air sign, glowing in red, is Brian. He's looked better.

acts.label: Get Brian out of the chair

highway.name: The Highway
highway.locked: Brice has been here for too long. You'll need to rescue Brian first!

pumps.name: The Gas n' Guzzle
pumps.desc: Sixteen pumps. Now with some actually working! A suss-as-hell black van sits in the back, smoke billows from it's rocking engine. You recognize the "Faatherton" spray painted on the side, because you wrote it. The diner food smells edible-ish.

acts.label: Talk to the trucker at pump nine
Dig through the parts shelf
acts.say: Fourteen serpentine belts, none the right size. You take the one that is wrong by the least.

acts.label: Look in the van
acts.say: On the bench seat under a folded map: a looper pedal, still plugged into nothing, still switched on.

diner.name: Diner Counter (sticky)
diner.desc: Looks like the few seated patrons live here, and it smells like someone burned fish 7 seconds ago. Evidence of someone playing for tips is discernable from the greasy but empty tip jar in the corner.

acts.label: Take the pot  (item)
acts.say: She does not hand you a cup. She hands you the pot, and a look that says bring it back.

backlot.name: The Back Lot
backlot.desc: Ah, the memories. Every puke stain and pizza box brings you back. Underneath your long lost stead, Brice fidgets with the engine, still trying to get back on the road.

acts.label: Get the van running
acts.say: The belt is wrong by a little, which Brice says is the correct amount of wrong. The van turns over on the third try. Something enormous behind the building notices.

venue.name: THE VENUE
venue.locked: All 7 Faathertons or bust. You made a deal.

loadin.name: Load-In
loadin.desc: The door to the green room is propped open with an empty beer bottle. Stickers canvas what used to be a painted wall. One of them is yours. Put there by you. It's only partially scratched off.

green.name: The Green Room
green.desc: A couch that has seen some things and absorbed worse. An expired case of bottled water and a full ashtray greet you within, and there is no bathroom. All the other bands are here. Like, really all of them.

acts.label: Last call at the merch table

stage.name: The Stage
stage.desc: Two hundred people. The house lights drop. Somewhere in the squeal of the feedback, something dark begins to emerge. The ringing in your ears signifies that the grand finale is about to begin.

tape.name: A Warped Cassette
tape.desc: No label. Side A is forty minutes of a room tone.

fuzzbox.name: Orphaned Fuzz Pedal
fuzzbox.desc: Someone loved this once. The knob is a wine cork.

fortyfive.name: A 45 Nobody Has
fortyfive.desc: No sleeve, no label, one side worn smooth. The B-side is the good one.

cashew.name: The Last Cashew Chicken
cashew.desc: Springfield-style. Still hot. This is a serious object.

belt.name: A Serpentine Belt
belt.desc: Wrong size by a little. Every belt on this shelf is wrong by a little.

coffee.name: A Whole Pot Of Coffee
coffee.desc: Not a cup. The pot. The waitress said take the pot.

keycard.name: Gate Fob
keycard.desc: Opens the gate. Gary says it also opens his ex-wife's building.

flyers.bill: w/ THREE GUYS ON JET SKIS
